description: This file defines the AutoTranslationInterface interface for managing enterprise auto-translation features in Mattermost, including methods for checking feature availability, enabling status, performing translations, and managing resources.

methods.name: IsFeatureAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the auto-translation feature is available based on license, feature flag, and configuration.

methods.name: IsChannelEnabled
methods.description: Determines if auto-translation is enabled for a specific channel.

methods.name: IsUserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if auto-translation is enabled for a specific user in a channel.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Performs translation of content in a channel for a user.

methods.name: GetBatch
methods.description: Fetches a batch of translations for multiple object IDs and a target language.

methods.name: GetUserLanguage
methods.description: Returns the preferred language of a user in a channel for auto-translation.

methods.name: DetectRemote
methods.description: Detects the language of provided text using a remote provider.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the auto-translation implementation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the auto-translation service.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the auto-translation service.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Creates a worker for recovering stuck translations.

methods.name: MakeScheduler
methods.description: Creates a scheduler for periodic recovery of stuck translations.
